scope: Correction only: rights evidence moved to the Copyright Act version of 1 February 2023, and the basis is described more narrowly. No election figure changes.

owner_decisions.decision: Owner reply: read the State Commission minutes on minv.sk and publish national figures only, on Copyright Act § 5(a) and (b); no statistics.sk contact.
Owner brief: verify the rights evidence against the February 2023 version, correct outdated references and document remaining uncertainty, without weakening the gate or assuming permission.

reuse_right.basis: Copyright Act § 5(a) excludes information. It is not established that the minutes are an official decision under § 5(b), or how the database right in § 135 applies. The gate stays closed only on the owner's decision of 2026-11-03, flagged for review with these findings.

normalized_republication.basis: Same basis and same uncertainty, national figures only.

raw_redistribution.basis: Only the section before the first elected candidate is archived, with the PDF checksum. Candidate names are not committed.

acquisition_route.basis: One request to www.minv.sk, whose robots.txt disallows only /?poslat-stranku. statistics.sk stays blocked and was not contacted.

source_files_complete.basis: The minutes hold voters on the rolls, voters who took part, turnout, votes and shares for 25 lists, and elected counts per list.

national_definition_complete.basis: List votes sum to the printed total; shares and turnout reproduce as truncated values; elected counts sum to 150 and match the printed totals of 33 women and 117 men. Invalid votes are not stated and not reconstructed.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: Each list keeps its number and printed name. A kind is stated only for the 7 lists that passed a threshold (6 parties, 1 coalition); 18 lists stay not established. Coalition members are not derived and coalition votes are never divided.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: Act 180/2014 Coll. §§ 66 and 68, version of 1 March 2023, quoted in the evidence record; the minutes apply the 5% and 7% thresholds.

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: The State Commission minutes are the final determination. Legal challenges to the result were not reviewed.

continuity: None: one election cannot form a series, and no party register was reviewed. continuous_party_series is 0.
